- **OBJECT-INDEX** (batch B0058, scope THEORY-LEVEL): The proposed mathematical/conceptual core of the whole Zero programme, generalizing the ten individual non-collapse invariants into one meta-principle: distinct epistemic boundary conditions (contradiction, absence, evidence insufficiency, unobservability, underdetermination, theory incompleteness, etc.) must not be identified with one another merely because a downstream evaluator projects them to the same coarse value (e.g. all to U).
